# Patches

What differs from upstream (`UPSTREAM`) in this directory: one row a change, in the commit that makes it.
`zig build check-specs` refuses a file whose bytes are not `MANIFEST.sha256`'s without a row here, and a row
whose file is upstream's as it was. A file added here, or an upstream file removed, is a change too. The path
is from this directory.

| File | What | Why | Proposed upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `zig/src/core/engine_request.zig` | `NoRepeat` (`size`, `window`, `whitelist`) and `Request.no_repeat`, empty by default | Unlimited-OCR's sliding-window no-repeat n-gram rule (`decode/ngram.zig`) is a per-request setting vLLM reads from `extra_args`; the engine reads it from its request (spec 137 WS-05) | No: upstream has no such rule |
| `zig/src/core/engine_request.zig` | `Request.max_page_tokens`, null by default | Unlimited-OCR-2's PageCountGuard caps a page of the reply at `max_page_tokens` tokens (the checkpoint's `_uocr_page_count_guard`, 20,000 by default); SGLang's v2 reads it from the request (spec 147 WS-06) | No: upstream has no such rule |
| `zig/src/core/engine_api.zig` | `Info.transcription` (null by default), `VTable.submit_transcription` (optional, the vtable's last) and `Engine.submitTranscription`, the types from `transcription_api.zig` | Speech to text (`POST /v1/audio/transcriptions`, spec 138 WS-05): the engine decodes the file, makes the prompt and reads the reply's text, as a vLLM model's `SupportsTranscription` does; an engine without the entry serves no such route | Not yet |
